callerLines: My date of birth is March 14th, 1990.
Yes please, I'd like to refill my Concerta.
Yes, that's right. Please order it.
I've had some mild headaches in the afternoon.
spoken: This is Maple Street Pharmacy calling for Sam Rivera. To continue, I'll send a code to this phone.
I'm sorry, I made a mistake there.
I tried to check the code before I had your date of birth, so that attempt didn't count for you.
It didn't verify, and I have two tries left.
Could you tell me your date of birth?
Please say the year, then the month, then the day.
Then read the code back to me once more, so I can check it.
A pharmacist will check it first, and I'll confirm once it's approved.
Sam, I'm calling because you asked to be reminded before your medicine runs out.
The prescription is for Concerta.
There is also a Metformin prescription on your account.
Would you like me to check how many refills are left on your Concerta?
A pharmacist will check it first, and I'll confirm once it's approved.
You have 2 refills left.
Here is what I have:
The drug is Concerta, 36 milligrams, tablets.
The label says: "Take 1 tablet by mouth every morning.
Qty 30."
On your plan, you would pay $4.10.
The plan pays $41.20.
Would you like me to request this refill?
Please say yes or no.
Your refill request for Concerta 36 milligrams has been sent.
A pharmacist needs to check it before it is approved.
A person will look at it, and we will confirm once it is approved.
Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Since your last refill, have you noticed any side effects, or anything else?
I'm sorry to hear about the headaches.
Could you tell me when they started?
Did they begin after your last refill, or before?
Thanks, I've passed that to the pharmacist with your refill.
Thank you for calling, Sam.
Take care.
